revisions.name: host-file
revisions.reason: Original MCM proved hostWrites=1 at real GPS binding inside observed gpu_stream_kick, with all captured owner identities equal and epochInvalid=0. Keep idle-host validation at writer attachment and synchronous-arm acknowledgment; validate captured owners, participants and unpoisoned epoch across each later bind await without demanding the observed host call has returned. Binding grants no source-read/publication authority; unchanged writer seals, retained pages and joins still qualify publication. No new callback, timer, subscription or cleanup owner: finite preparation timer, replacement/cancel/retirement invalidation, error-listener removal and onClose settlement remain unchanged. Actual production method regression covers active attachment and arm-ack refusal, active bind without publication, owner replacement and invalid epoch during acknowledgment. Existing ten GPS lifecycle tests pass.
